item.title: GTA VI gamers beware — experts warn of a 1300% rise in phishing scams ahead of official launch date
item.description: A massive surge in gaming related phishing emails has been detected, as scammers attempt to cash-in on the anticipation surrounding GTA VI’s release.

item.title: Elon Musk tries to explain what’s going on with Ukraine and Starlink
item.description: Elon Musk said Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy is lying about disruptions to Starshield in Ukraine and that he's trying to misuse SpaceX's consumer service, Starlink, for military purposes. Musk made the comments at The New York Times' DealBook Summit on Wednesday as he tried to explain the conflict following weeks of back and forth between […]...

item.title: China goes public with stealth UAV manned by crack team of 'self-trained female drone operators' — GJ-11 looks a lot like Northrop Grumman's X-47B now-defunct UCAV
item.description: China's latest GJ-11 footage reveals its weapons bays, sensors, landing gear, and exhaust while outlining planned strikes and fighter cooperation.
